caveats: agent labels are checked for citation resolution, not for scholarly quality
the human baseline is a single timed trial by one person

human_baseline.task: formalize one taxonomy (region of origin) for the 23 transmitted books: one label, one citation URL and a confidence mark per book
human_baseline.who: one team member who is familiar with these texts
human_baseline.tools_allowed: web search and encyclopedia pages; no AI assistance; the agent's region taxonomy was not seen beforehand
human_baseline.notes: single timed trial; labels with known answers were filled from memory and a supporting page was then looked up

agreement_with_agent_region_taxonomy.note: partition agreement, independent of label names; human used 12 fine-grained state labels, the agent 6 broader regional cultures
